en.authority: Czech Ministry of Foreign Affairs / e-Sbírka
en.text: Article 10 — Dividends. The official DPR Korea–Czech Republic treaty provides a 10 per cent source-State ceiling on dividends where the recipient is the beneficial owner. The permanent-establishment effective-connection exception applies. This is a concise English synthesis of the official treaty text; the official text controls.

en.authority: Czech Ministry of Foreign Affairs / e-Sbírka
en.text: Article 11 — Interest. The official DPR Korea–Czech Republic treaty provides source-State exemption where the lender is the other Contracting State, its subnational or local authority, or a resident of that State and the borrower is the source State, its subnational or local authority, its central bank or a government-controlled financial institution. In all other cases the source-State ceiling is 10 per cent where the recipient is the beneficial owner. This is a concise English synthesis of the official treaty text; the official text controls.

en.authority: Czech Ministry of Foreign Affairs / e-Sbírka
en.text: Article 12 — Royalties. The official DPR Korea–Czech Republic treaty provides a 10 per cent source-State ceiling on royalties where the recipient is the beneficial owner. The permanent-establishment effective-connection exception applies. This is a concise English synthesis of the official treaty text; the official text controls.
